answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities burn money. Each new agent pays a non-refundable 30 POA fee, an ember lit before it can trade, and the fee is burned, never returned. The kernel is arithmetic: 1,000 fakes cost 30,000 POA, while one epoch's harvest totals under 3,000 POA, so the attack loses 27,000 POA first. Over a 30-epoch horizon the tax rises for churned identities, while an honest agent pays once and earns the full unshared reward pool.
